query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Quenby . Is there any Quenby tee listing with size M available to buy for under $13? Answer yes or no, and name the seller if yes.

Before answering, open every tee listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check every option the question needs on each one. Listings of anything else in the results are not part of the question and need not be opened. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: Yes. There is a Quenby tee with size M available for under $13: the 'Quenby Midweight Jersey Tee, Short Sleeve' from seller Gisburn Clothing Co, priced $12.58 in size M (http://localhost:7770/igr-rp28-02.html). I opened all 45 Quenby tee listings across both search-result pages (36 on page 1, 9 on page 2) and checked size options and prices on each. No other M-size tee was under $13: e.g., Fairhaven Outfitters M=$13.95, Garrick Workwear M=$15.33, Marchmont M=$26.43; Pembroke/Thornbury/Redhill/Copperfield/Oakfield had M disabled; Ashgrove/Fordwich/Brockwell/Carnforth/Kelsall/Ambleside/Bramley/Dalston/Kettering/Alderney had no M option at all.
